summary: Iter 53 — 4 approved features: (1) Buy More BigCoin (Stripe topup), (2) Gift Card scratch-reveal + send-thanks, (3) Video PIP button, (4) Booking Reminders. BACKEND (pytest test_iter53_topup_reveal_reminders.py): 13/13 pass. BigCoin topup: /packages returns 4 items + points_balance (auth-gated, 401 without token), tp_500/1000/2500/5000 with correct total_bigcoin = bigcoin+bonus; /checkout with bogus package → 404, valid tp_500 → 200 with checkout_url starting https:// + session_id starting cs_; /status returns 'pending' before pay, 404 on unknown session. Gift Cards: /mine returns received_gift for all cards; POST /reveal on owned card flips revealed=true; POST /reveal on unknown → 404; POST /thanks on self-purchased returns 400 no_gifter (as spec); seeded a gifted card via mongo (buyer!=recipient) → /mine shows received_gift=true, /reveal ok, /thanks 200, thanks_sent flips to true, and a giftcard_thanks entry lands in station_notifications for the buyer's user_id. Bookings: /mine returns items with sponsor_name+venue_title (status=confirmed); POST /book enqueues a booking_reminder notification into station_notifications AND it surfaces in GET /api/me/notifications. MOBILE (Expo web preview, 390x844, demo login): /bigcoin-topup renders topup-root, topup-balance=788, all 4 topup-pkg-* buttons, topup-need-banner appears with ?needed=200 param; wallet tab shows wallet-topup-btn (labeled 'Top Up'); /giftcards Shop tab → after selecting method=points + gc-amt-5000 (>balance), gc-topup-gc_grind_coffee nudge renders; /giftcards My Cards tab shows the demo's own card (self-purchased) so no scratch/thanks UI (spec-expected — received_gift=false for self-purchased); /bookings renders bookings-reminder banner with 3 bk-mine-* lines from prior bookings. PIP: verified via source inspection at /app/mobile/app/podcast/episode/[id].tsx:352 — testID='mobile-episode-pip-btn' inside EpisodeVideoBlock which renders only when media.video_url is truthy (line 211). No video episode exists in DB (podcast_episodes has 0 with media_type=video / video_storage_key), so the button can't be rendered against real data without seeding video content + storage key. Spec explicitly says 'functional PIP only on native build; just verify the button renders where a video episode exists' — code is present but preview validation blocked by data.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot verify mobile-episode-pip-btn rendering in preview — no episode with a valid video_storage_key (or any media_type='video') exists in podcast_episodes. Media endpoint /api/podcasts/episodes/{id}/media derives video_url only from a signed URL against ep.video_storage_key (see /app/backend/routes/creator_video.py:44-50); a raw ep.video_url field is not surfaced. Seeded test data with video_url string was ignored; adding video_storage_key would fail signing against Tigris in preview. Suggest seeding one demo video episode via Creator Studio upload flow so QA can validate the button renders.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/bigcoin_topup.py:71 — origin_url falls back to BIGFM_PUBLIC_BASE_URL. Currently mobile client passes EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL which is the API host; success_url therefore points at the backend URL rather than a real completion screen. Same pattern flagged for gift cards in iter52 — one shared fix would be to accept null and prefer BIGFM_PUBLIC_BASE_URL server-side.

backend/routes/bigcoin_topup.py:97-120 — /{session_id}/status has no ownership check: any authenticated user knowing a session_id could poll another user's topup. Consider filtering by `user_id: user['user_id']` on find_one (or verifying rec['user_id'] == uid before returning).

backend/routes/gift_cards.py:238-242 — reveal_card issues an unconditional $set revealed=true even if already revealed (safe but wasteful) and does not gate on gift_to_email — self-purchased cards are already revealed by construction (line 79) but the endpoint has no `revealed==false` precondition, so a caller can force revealed_at to update repeatedly. Consider `{revealed: {$ne: true}}` in the update filter.

backend/routes/merchant_marketplace.py:807-816 — booking_reminder enqueue is wrapped in try/except with only a logger.warning; a failure here would silently ship a booking with no reminder. That's acceptable for MVP but consider promoting to a background job with retry, since spec calls out the reminder as a primary feature.

mobile/app/bigcoin-topup.tsx:42 — origin_url: process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — see backend note above; this URL is not a user-facing surface. Consider omitting so server falls back to BIGFM_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.

mobile/app/podcast/episode/[id].tsx:352 — PIP button UI is present and testID-tagged, but there is no user-facing indication that PIP is a native-only capability (per spec). Consider a subtle 'Requires native app' hint or dev-only badge to avoid confused taps in preview.
